name: kiki-uu-remote
description: Discover, preview, and operate NetEase UU Remote (GameViewer) desktop sessions with zero-focus background capture, symmetric black-bar trimming, uuyc-cli device management, Human Takeover lock, and kiki.cua.provider.v1 integration.
author: Kiki

interface.shortDescription: Live NetEase UU Remote screen preview and desktop control

zh-CN.shortDescription: 网易 UU远程桌面实时画面预览、后台无焦点抓帧与接管操控

systemPrompt: Use the uu-remote skill for NetEase UU Remote (GameViewer) remote desktop tasks. Inspect sessions and paired devices with uu_sessions or uu_status first; use uu_launch to open the client, connect/disconnect a specific deviceId via official uuyc-cli (never omit deviceId on disconnect), or rescue off-screen windows. Observe and control uu:<hwnd> streaming windows via uu_control with normalized_1000 [0..1000] coordinates (black bars are trimmed automatically) or through kiki-cua over the kiki.cua.provider.v1 bus. Stop immediately and yield to the user when Human Takeover (human_takeover_active) is engaged, and avoid Ctrl+Alt+* shortcuts reserved by the local UU Remote overlay.

executablePath.title: GameViewer executable path
executablePath.description: Optional custom path to GameViewer.exe or UU Remote app bundle.

cliPath.title: uuyc-cli executable path
cliPath.description: Optional custom path to official uuyc-cli binary.

restorePreviousFocus.title: Restore previous foreground window
restorePreviousFocus.description: Restore focus to the previously active local window after sending remote input (waits 65ms mouse-up settle).

autoTrimBlackBars.title: Auto-trim letterbox/pillarbox bars
autoTrimBlackBars.description: Automatically crop symmetric black margins so [0..1000] coordinates map 1:1 onto the remote desktop.

takeoverThresholdPx.title: Human takeover cursor threshold (px)
takeoverThresholdPx.description: Physical cursor movement in pixels during active agent control that automatically locks Human Takeover.

remoteAspect.title: Remote screen aspect override
remoteAspect.description: Optional fixed aspect ratio (for example 16:9 or 16:10) when overriding automatic black-bar detection.

tools.name: uu_status
tools.description: Detect local NetEase UU Remote (GameViewer & uuyc-cli) installation, running client/service processes, uuremote:// URI registration, official uuyc-cli diagnostics, CUA Provider Bus lease status, and active remote desktop session summary.

includeCliStatus.description: Query official uuyc-cli status --json when uuyc-cli is installed.

tools.name: uu_sessions
tools.description: List open UU Remote streaming windows (uu:<hwnd> with active/minimized/offscreen state, inner stage bounds, contentRect, DPI, takeover status) alongside paired uuyc-cli devices and remote terminal sessions; select default session; or toggle Human Takeover.

action.description: List sessions and paired devices, select default uu:<hwnd> session, or toggle Human Takeover lock.

sessionId.description: Target streaming session ID (uu:<hwnd>) for select or takeover.

active.description: For action="takeover": true locks Human Takeover (pausing agent input), false releases back to agent.

reason.description: Optional note recorded when engaging or releasing Human Takeover.

probeContentRect.description: Capture a background frame on active windows to compute exact black-bar contentRect.

includeDevices.description: Include paired online/offline devices from uuyc-cli device list/status.

includeTerminals.description: Query uuyc-cli term -d <deviceId> ls --json for remote terminal sessions.

deviceId.description: Optional paired device ID filter when includeTerminals=true.

tools.name: uu_control
tools.description: Observe a zero-focus background screenshot (with symmetric black-bar trim and optional zoom crop) or inject mouse, keyboard, clipboard, focus, or restore actions into an active UU Remote session (uu:<hwnd>). Honors Human Takeover.

sessionId.description: Target streaming session ID (uu:<hwnd>). Defaults to the selected or sole active session.

action.description: Single action to perform when actions[] batch is not provided.

actions.description: Optional sequence of input/clipboard actions executed in order.

coordinateMode.description: Coordinate space for x/y, drag endpoints, scroll anchor, and zoom bounds.

text.description: Text payload for type or clipboard_set.

key.description: Key name or chord such as Enter, Escape, Tab, Ctrl+C, Win+R.

keys.description: Key chord array such as ["Ctrl", "Shift", "Esc"]. Avoid Ctrl+Alt+* client hotkeys.

zoom.description: Optional crop region in coordinateMode units extracted at native stream resolution before scaling.

autoTrimBlackBars.description: Override autoTrimBlackBars setting for this call.

remoteAspect.description: Optional aspect override (e.g. "16:9" or "16:10") for black-bar cropping.

observeAfter.description: Capture and attach a fresh screenshot after mutating actions.

overrideHumanTakeover.description: Proceed even when Human Takeover is active (use only when explicitly requested by the user).

allowClientHotkey.description: Allow Ctrl+Alt+* chords that normally trigger UU Remote local overlay/fullscreen shortcuts.

tools.name: uu_launch
tools.description: Open the NetEase UU Remote desktop client, connect or disconnect a specific paired device via official uuyc-cli, launch an explicit uuremote:// URI, or rescue off-screen GameViewer windows back onto the primary monitor.

action.description: Lifecycle or window-recovery operation to execute.

deviceId.description: Required target device ID for connect_device and disconnect_device (never omitted on disconnect_device).

uri.description: Explicit uuremote:// or gameviewer:// URI for action="open_uri".

sessionId.description: Optional uu:<hwnd> filter for recover_offscreen; omit to rescue all off-screen GameViewer windows.

waitForWindowMs.description: Milliseconds to poll for newly opened session windows after open_client, connect_device, or open_uri.
